from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
import os, tempfile
p=Path('/home/user/workspace/c16/experiment_metrics.xlsx')
ns='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', ns)
ET.register_namespace('r','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships')
ET.register_namespace('xdr','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/spreadsheetDrawing')
ET.register_namespace('x14','http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main')
ET.register_namespace('mc','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006')
def q(tag): return f'{{{ns}}}{tag}'
rows = [
 ['Model_ID','Batch_Size','Latency_ms','Throughput_qps','Mem_GB'],
 ['Model-A',16,110,82,12],
 ['Model-B',16,124.0,78.5,16],
 ['Model-C',32,95.0,94.0,16.0],
 ['Model-D',32,130.0,76.0,20.0],
 ['Model-E',64,88.0,109.5,24.0],
]
with ZipFile(p,'r') as zin:
    files={info.filename:(info,zin.read(info.filename)) for info in zin.infolist()}
# Parse existing shared strings and keep current indices stable.
ssroot=ET.fromstring(files['xl/sharedStrings.xml'][1])
strings=[]
for si in ssroot.findall(q('si')):
    t=si.find(q('t'))
    strings.append(''.join((x.text or '') for x in si.iter(q('t'))))
lookup={s:i for i,s in enumerate(strings)}
for row in rows:
    for value in row:
        if isinstance(value,str) and value not in lookup:
            si=ET.SubElement(ssroot,q('si'))
            t=ET.SubElement(si,q('t'))
            t.text=value
            lookup[value]=len(strings)
            strings.append(value)
# Load the worksheet and alter only A1:E6.
sroot=ET.fromstring(files['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'][1])
sdata=sroot.find(q('sheetData'))
rowmap={int(r.get('r')):r for r in sdata.findall(q('row'))}
for ri, vals in enumerate(rows,1):
    r=rowmap.get(ri)
    if r is None:
        r=ET.Element(q('row'),{'r':str(ri)})
        sdata.append(r)
        rowmap[ri]=r
    cells={c.get('r'):c for c in r.findall(q('c'))}
    for ci,val in enumerate(vals,1):
        col=chr(64+ci)
        ref=f'{col}{ri}'
        c=cells.get(ref)
        if c is None:
            c=ET.Element(q('c'),{'r':ref,'s':'0'})
            cells[ref]=c
        # Preserve existing cell style; replace only its value/type.
        for child in list(c): c.remove(child)
        if isinstance(val,str):
            c.set('t','s')
            ET.SubElement(c,q('v')).text=str(lookup[val])
        else:
            c.set('t','n')
            # Keep requested decimal precision in the stored numeric text.
            txt=str(val)
            ET.SubElement(c,q('v')).text=txt
    # Reorder cells in the row without changing any cells outside A:E.
    ordered=sorted(cells.values(), key=lambda c: (sum((ord(ch)-64)*26**i for i,ch in enumerate(reversed(''.join(filter(str.isalpha,c.get('r')))))), c.get('r')))
    for c in r.findall(q('c')): r.remove(c)
    for c in ordered: r.append(c)
# Update shared-string bookkeeping.
uses=sum(1 for c in sroot.iter(q('c')) if c.get('t')=='s')
ssroot.set('count',str(uses))
ssroot.set('uniqueCount',str(len(strings)))
files['xl/sharedStrings.xml']=(files['xl/sharedStrings.xml'][0],ET.tostring(ssroot,encoding='UTF-8',xml_declaration=True))
files['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml']=(files['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'][0],ET.tostring(sroot,encoding='UTF-8',xml_declaration=True))
# Replace via a temporary file so the workbook remains a valid ZIP archive.
tmp=p.with_suffix('.tmp.xlsx')
with ZipFile(tmp,'w') as zout:
    for name,(info,data) in files.items():
        zout.writestr(info,data)
os.replace(tmp,p)
print('Updated A1:E6 only.')

p=Path('/home/user/workspace/c16/experiment_metrics.xlsx')
ns='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('', ns)
ET.register_namespace('r','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships')
ET.register_namespace('xdr','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/spreadsheetDrawing')
ET.register_namespace('x14','http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/spreadsheetml/2009/9/main')
ET.register_namespace('mc','http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006')
def q(tag): return f'{{{ns}}}{tag}'
rows = [
 ['Model_ID','Batch_Size','Latency_ms','Throughput_qps','Mem_GB'],
 ['Model-A',16,110,82,12],
 ['Model-B',16,124.0,78.5,16],
 ['Model-C',32,95.0,94.0,16.0],
 ['Model-D',32,130.0,76.0,20.0],
 ['Model-E',64,88.0,109.5,24.0],
]
with ZipFile(p,'r') as zin:
    files={info.filename:(info,zin.read(info.filename)) for info in zin.infolist()}
# Parse existing shared strings and keep current indices stable.
ssroot=ET.fromstring(files['xl/sharedStrings.xml'][1])
strings=[]
for si in ssroot.findall(q('si')):
    t=si.find(q('t'))
    strings.append(''.join((x.text or '') for x in si.iter(q('t'))))
lookup={s:i for i,s in enumerate(strings)}
for row in rows:
    for value in row:
        if isinstance(value,str) and value not in lookup:
            si=ET.SubElement(ssroot,q('si'))
            t=ET.SubElement(si,q('t'))
            t.text=value
            lookup[value]=len(strings)
            strings.append(value)
# Load the worksheet and alter only A1:E6.
sroot=ET.fromstring(files['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'][1])
sdata=sroot.find(q('sheetData'))
rowmap={int(r.get('r')):r for r in sdata.findall(q('row'))}
for ri, vals in enumerate(rows,1):
    r=rowmap.get(ri)
    if r is None:
        r=ET.Element(q('row'),{'r':str(ri)})
        sdata.append(r)
        rowmap[ri]=r
    cells={c.get('r'):c for c in r.findall(q('c'))}
    for ci,val in enumerate(vals,1):
        col=chr(64+ci)
        ref=f'{col}{ri}'
        c=cells.get(ref)
        if c is None:
            c=ET.Element(q('c'),{'r':ref,'s':'0'})
            cells[ref]=c
        # Preserve existing cell style; replace only its value/type.
        for child in list(c): c.remove(child)
        if isinstance(val,str):
            c.set('t','s')
            ET.SubElement(c,q('v')).text=str(lookup[val])
        else:
            c.set('t','n')
            # Keep requested decimal precision in the stored numeric text.
            txt=str(val)
            ET.SubElement(c,q('v')).text=txt
    # Reorder cells in the row without changing any cells outside A:E.
    ordered=sorted(cells.values(), key=lambda c: (sum((ord(ch)-64)*26**i for i,ch in enumerate(reversed(''.join(filter(str.isalpha,c.get('r')))))), c.get('r')))
    for c in r.findall(q('c')): r.remove(c)
    for c in ordered: r.append(c)
# Update shared-string bookkeeping.
uses=sum(1 for c in sroot.iter(q('c')) if c.get('t')=='s')
ssroot.set('count',str(uses))
ssroot.set('uniqueCount',str(len(strings)))
files['xl/sharedStrings.xml']=(files['xl/sharedStrings.xml'][0],ET.tostring(ssroot,encoding='UTF-8',xml_declaration=True))
files['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml']=(files['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'][0],ET.tostring(sroot,encoding='UTF-8',xml_declaration=True))
# Replace via a temporary file so the workbook remains a valid ZIP archive.
tmp=p.with_suffix('.tmp.xlsx')
with ZipFile(tmp,'w') as zout:
    for name,(info,data) in files.items():
        zout.writestr(info,data)
os.replace(tmp,p)
print('Updated A1:E6 only.')
